summary: ACCEPT at 7276d5d3. Item 3, dead-target cancel bound. THE CENTRAL CLAIM VERIFIES: the reset is identity-scoped to the target BrokerOrder.id, the state is DURABLE in Postgres via broker_order_events, there is no in-memory counter anywhere, and a fresh service object against the same DB stays bounded - so no reset on HELD, elapsed time, position state, restart, reconnection or session. The prior unreachable anti-pattern is NOT rebuilt. Reachability was proven on the PRODUCTION intent shape rather than asserted: _queue_resting_cancel emits cancels with no target_client_order_id and no broker_order_id, so find_open_order_for_cancel takes its newest-open-order fallback; ten such cancels produce 1 broker request and 9 local refusals. A legitimate cancel still reaches the broker (new coid embeds event_id, record_order upserts by coid, so a new placement always gets a fresh row and fresh budget; the watchdog replace is cancel-plus-new-coid, never in-place). The LASE replay asserts the full shape including that the 47 local refusals do NOT counterfeit broker events, and a genuine mutation control exists. FOLLOW-UPS, none able to strand a live order. (1) SCOPE: three sibling cancel paths - _refresh_working_order, _run_drift_cancel, _cancel_working_order_and_abandon_intent - submit cancels directly, record nothing on refusal, and are therefore both unbounded AND invisible to this bound. The claim must read 'strategy-emitted cancel intents only'; _refresh_working_order is the KUST refresh-loop shape and remains uncovered. (2) The classifier is TWO LITERAL SCHWAB STRINGS; a trailing period, an HTTP prefix, or any other terminal wording un-bounds it, and Webull is entirely uncovered - a broker-shaped rule with no broker scope, harmless only because no other venue emits these strings. Fail-open is the correct direction for live money, but the reach must be stated. (3) No event_source=='broker' filter, though the column exists precisely to stop client aborts counting as broker rejects; latent, one-line hardening. ALSO: bounded at the wire, not the emitter - 48 intents and 47 warnings still written, only broker traffic drops 48 to 1. ⛔ GRADING: post-deploy this reads UNEXERCISED. In all retained live history the v2 path contributes 3 terminal-family events, each a FIRST refusal, so the bound would have fired ZERO times. A quiet log is not a pass. ⛔ The LASE 2026-06-02 episode is NOT documented anywhere in the repo - it exists only in a code comment and a test docstring. Corroborated indirectly, but the durable query must be produced before 48-to-1 is recorded as a graded fact.
